body:
I think this is because of how we wire these as dependencies and then we trigger dependency resolution sooner than we should. 
We had a similar problem that these were build on `assemble` as well that we worked around specifically. Looks like we need a more elaborate fix.

issue.title: Don't do BWC packaing tests if disabled

labels.name: :Delivery/Packaging
labels.description: RPM and deb packaging, tar and zip archives, shell and batch scripts

repository.name: elasticsearch
repository.description: Free and Open Source, Distributed, RESTful Search Engine

issue.body:
Packaging tests did not honor bwc tests being off.
We run bwc versions if there's any dependency on them, so this is the 
reason for which we were building  the BWC versions
even if the tests are tured off, so this also closes #35347.

The upgrade tests already know how to deal with the "from version" being current.
